topic: Daily Routines & Labiodental Sounds (V vs F vs B)
learning_objective: Practice full sentence repetitions for daily routines and feelings while mastering labiodental fricatives /v/ and /f/ and softening ejective stops /k/ and /t/.
afaan_oromoo_intro_script: Baga gara Sadarkaa Lammaffaatti dhuftan! Har'a sochiilee guyyaa guyyaa fi sagalee 'V' fi 'F' hidhii gubbaafi ilkaan fayyadamuun baranna. Jechoota laaffisnee dubbifna!

voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: Ilkaan gubbaa hidhii jalaatti qabiitii 'Van' jedhi. Akka 'Ban' hin ta'in, sagaleen /v/ hollachuu qaba.

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: Ilkaan kee gubbaa hidhii kee gadii irra kaa'i: /v/. Afaan Oromoo keessatti /v/ waan hin jirreef akka /b/ hin jenne!

voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: Sagalee 'k' fi 't' akka qubee Afaan Oromoo cimee dhohu (k', t') osoo hin taane laaffisaa dubbadhaa.

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: Kokkee kee keessaa cimsitee hin dhoosin; Ingiliffa keessatti 'clean' sagalee laafaa qaba!
Sagalee /f/ fi /p/ adda baasi: 'Face' malee 'Pace' miti.

voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: Hima guuti: Ganama barii maal dhugda? 'I drink fresh milk' jedhii dubbadhu.

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: Sagalee /d/ akka 'dh' Afaan Oromoo hin dubbisin; arraba laaftuu godhi.
